title: Acts of the Third Council (Ephesus)
english: I read the Acts of the third council, the council of Ephesus, made up almost wholly of Saint Cyril's letters to Nestorius, with that impious man's replies to him.
translator_notes: Greek locked from Bekker 1824; Freese 1920 used as PD English reference only.
Codex 16 of 279; Acts of the Third Council of Ephesus (431). Cyril of Alexandria (archbishop 412-444); Nestorius of Constantinople (428-431), deposed for heresy.
